title: Geologic map of the Hardeeville and Rincon quadrangles, Beaufort and Jasper counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2008, Geologic map of the Hardeeville and Rincon quadrangles, Beaufort and Jasper counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-152, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Two sheets: Hardeeville (page 1) and Rincon (page 2, mostly Georgia). Map symbols read on the Hardeeville map face and section images. OCR 'Thickness | to 40 feet' read as 1 (inferred, unclear). 45 SCGS drill-hole labels read on the Hardeeville map face; Rincon shows none. Eolian and fringe deposits described on the Rincon explanation (page 2); ('Fringe deposits') has a clipped OCR name. Section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 100) hole labels and unit labels read; hole tops and contacts not digitized. SUBSURFACE: Jasper sediments generally between 10 and 20 ft elevation (no datum printed); section contacts not digitized.
